content: Customer Vivaan Gupta called about his expired travel policy TRV-001234, discovered it expired on March 10, and asked about options. Agent Neha Kapoor explained reinstatement or a new quote; Vivaan chose to get a new quote. The agent then requested his date of birth (12 August 1990) to begin the quoting process.
